summary:
ASTRA-CARE: AI-Powered Astronaut Health Monitoring and Research Analytics Platform

ASTRA-CARE is an AI/ML-powered platform developed to support astronaut health monitoring and research analysis during space missions. The project uses NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), particularly dataset OSD-575, to explore astronaut health patterns and biomarker variations.

The platform combines a modern mission-control-style dashboard, astronaut profiles, health records, research visualizations, and AI-driven pattern analysis. We developed a FastAPI backend integrated with Supabase and a KMeans machine learning model to analyze health-related data and identify patterns through clustering.

ASTRA-CARE addresses the challenges of monitoring astronaut health in the demanding space environment by bringing research data, visualization, and AI-based analysis into one integrated platform. It aims to help researchers explore health trends, identify patterns, and support data-informed research.

The project is important because astronaut health is essential for mission safety, performance, and the success of long-duration space exploration. ASTRA-CARE demonstrates how artificial intelligence and aerospace research can work together to support a healthier future in space.

Note: The platform is a research and monitoring prototype, not a clinically validated diagnostic system.
details: ASTRA-CARE is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring system designed to support astronaut well-being during space missions. It uses NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) datasets to analyse health records and biomarkers, identify patterns, and detect potential health risks. The system integrates machine learning, including K-Means clustering, to group health patterns and provide data-driven insights. Its benefits include continuous health assessment, early identification of unusual health changes, and improved decision-making for astronaut healthcare. Our intended impact is to contribute to safer, longer-duration space missions by supporting proactive health monitoring. We developed ASTRA-CARE using Python, FastAPI, React, JavaScript, Supabase, and machine-learning libraries, with NASA research datasets as the foundation. The project is creative because it combines space science, healthcare, AI, and data analytics into one platform. Our team considered data reliability, astronaut safety, usability, scalability, privacy, and the challenges of monitoring human health in microgravity environments.
